verdict.rationale: PagerDuty documents a broad REST API for accessing and changing account configuration: users, notification rules, incident workflows, on-call lookups and manual incident creation. It also offers the Events API, SCIM, v3 webhook subscriptions, published OpenAPI schemas, an interactive API reference and an official MCP server, so much of the core platform is programmable. Nothing in the evidence claims or shows UI parity, and many UI features (Post-Incident Reviews, Status Pages, the AI agents) have no documented API coverage. missing for 10: an explicit API/UI parity statement, documented API coverage for Post-Incident Reviews, Status Pages and Advance agents, independent hands-on confirmation of parity.
